# Trichy Fetal Medicine and Fertility Centre

> Specialist fetal medicine centre in Thillai Nagar, Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India. Offers pregnancy scans, screening tests (OSCAR, NIPT), fetal diagnostics and procedures, genetic counselling, and specialist clinics for twins, recurrent miscarriage and pregnancy loss. Founded 2012. In line with the PCPNDT Act, fetal sex determination is not performed or disclosed.
